items.label: multiple_source_of_truth
items.title: Source of truth split across files
items.summary: Thin KB and canonical KB are both treated as authoritative.

items.label: skill_entrypoint_overload
items.title: SKILL.md entrypoint overload
items.summary: Phase, notes, bridges, and portability all get stuffed into the entrypoint and trigger line-count warnings.

items.label: portability_breakage
items.title: Absolute path or sibling dependency accumulation
items.summary: Absolute paths and raw sibling links make portable installs break.

items.label: artifact_path_unverified
items.title: Artifact path recorded without file existence verification
items.summary: Evaluators can accidentally accept nonexistent artifacts if file existence is not checked.

items.label: manual_quick_validate_interpretation
items.title: quick_validate result interpreted manually
items.summary: Humans copy quick_validate verdicts instead of using a normalized capture artifact.

items.label: smoke_exitcode_stdout_mismatch
items.title: Smoke exit code and stdout status mismatch
items.summary: Invalid smoke cases can be misclassified when only exit code is checked.

items.label: warning_failure_not_separated
items.title: Warnings and failures treated at the same severity
items.summary: Warnings are collapsed into invalid and block next-slice gating too aggressively.

items.label: next_slice_candidate_inferred_globally
items.title: Next-slice candidate inferred from global process instead of local checklist
items.summary: Domain-specific next-slice order gets lost when the global process tries to choose the next slice.

items.label: slice_term_collision
items.title: Slice terminology collision
items.summary: Slice may mean planner output slice, implementation slice, or contract slice depending on context.

items.label: vertical_slice_note_missing
items.title: Smoke and evidence exist but vertical-slice note is missing
items.summary: Artifacts exist without a note that explains the goal, result, and next candidate.

items.label: capture_artifact_not_connected_to_evaluator
items.title: Capture artifact exists but is not connected to evaluator input
items.summary: Capture artifacts are produced but no canonical bridge normalizes them into the evaluator bundle.

items.label: small_remaining_slice_not_delegated
items.title: Small remaining slice not delegated even though ownership is separable
items.summary: Main agent keeps all remaining work even when bounded subagent delegation would be cleaner.
